title: A Systemic Screening for TB Disease in High-risk Groups in Barcelona
official: Implementing a Systemic Screening for TB Disease in High-risk Groups in Barcelona Area
summary: The purpose of this screening study is to identify and screen vulnerable population in Barcelona for active pulmonary tuberculosis
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

-Belonging to a population at high risk for tuberculosis (TB)

Exclusion Criteria:

-Not belonging to a population at high risk for tuberculosis (TB)
sponsor: Fundació Institut Germans Trias i Pujol
